messages.body:
<https://airflowsummit.org>

*Dear Apache Airflow Community,*


Airflow Summit is coming up. This year’s program is built around three
focused tracks designed for every stage of your Airflow journey, take a
look at the schedule and secure your spot *while there are still free
workshop spots & the Early Bird pricing is still available. *

Full program <https://airflowsummit.org/program/>
<https://airflowsummit.org/sessions/2026/>

🔹 *Builder Track: *Deep dives into DAGs, deployments, performance, and
scaling Airflow in production


🔹 *Data & AI Application Track: *Real-world use cases across analytics, ML
pipelines, and AI workflows


🔹 *Data Strategy Track: *Governance, adoption, and how organizations scale
Airflow effectively


Beyond the sessions, you’ll also find hands-on workshops
<https://airflowsummit.org/workshops/>, keynotes
<https://airflowsummit.org/keynotes/>, and plenty of opportunities to
connect with the community.


*If you’re traveling to join us, we’ve secured a special rate at the Hyatt
Regency for attendees. <https://airflowsummit.org/venue/> *

We recommend booking early while availability lasts.

*⚠️ Workshop spots and discounted hotel rooms are limited*


Get discounted ticket <https://airflowsummit.org/tickets/>


See you in Austin!

*The Airflow Summit Team*
